high_level_description: The image depicts an artist's rendering of the proposed renovation of Chicago's O'Hare International Airport. The design features a futuristic and modern architectural style with a large, curved, glass-paneled structure that dominates the foreground. This structure appears to be part of a new terminal or concourse, characterized by its sleek, geometric patterns and reflective surfaces. In the background, there is a control tower with a traditional design, standing tall and cylindrical, which contrasts with the contemporary look of the new terminal.
